purpose: Test agent access to original lesson PDFs on GitHub without full-book OCR

source.edition_note: نسخهٔ آرشیوی رسمی چاپ ۱۳۹۹، برای آزمایش؛ این پوشه ادعای چاپ جاری ندارد.

split_method: Original vector/text PDF pages retained with PyMuPDF select, preserving source document color profile; no OCR, retyping, rasterization or page cropping. Unused resources removed on save.
page_numbering_note: PDF index is 1-based and equals printed page numbering in these selected ranges.
boundary_policy: Each lesson starts at its title and includes its workshop and immediately following supplementary reading; no next lesson, preface, chapter separator or blank page.
